items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: including Paul Whiteman. So I got to meet a lot of these people whom I had been hearing only on records and on the radio

ctx.x: Did any of these groups come by your home town, early on?

Later, but by that time I was in high school and I was now in the house band at the Eagles Ballroom. And we had many bands coming in across the country to play opposite, including Paul Whiteman. So I got to meet a lot of these people whom I had been hearing only on records and on the radio, and getting to meet them. And these were important times for me, very important.
